forklift.source: forklift environment (forklift/operator.py): the G1 seated in the truck cab. Gains are authored estimates by the rule of the H1-2 forklift profile (kp = URDF effort limit / a saturation angle per joint class: hips 0.8 rad, knee and ankles 1.0, waist 0.667, shoulders 0.333, elbow 0.225, wrists 0.475, Dex3 fingers 0.333; kd/kp as there); effort and velocity limits are the pinned URDF's; armature is the reflected rotor inertia of each joint's Unitree motor class (batting/actuators.py: mjlab g1_constants / Unitree; ankles and waist roll/pitch two 5020s) and 1e-3 kg m^2 on the Dex3 fingers (batting DEX3_ARMATURE, estimate)

sources.extraction: Exact effective legacy controller values; no retuning
